Quinn]] | java1=[[Tsuguo Mogami]]}} '''Lysandre's Pyroar''' (Japanese: '''フラダリのカエンジシ''' ''Fuladari's Kaenjishi'') is the first known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Lysandre]] owns in {{aniseries|PTS}} and [[Pokémon Generations]]. He has also appeared in the {{pkmn|games}} and {{pkmn|manga}}. In [[Pokémon Adventures]], Pyroar is [[level]] 51. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== =====[[Mega Evolution Specials]]===== [[File:Lysandre and Pyroar.png|thumb|left|250px|Pyroar with Lysandre]] Prior to the events of ''Mega Evolution Special II'', he fought [[Alain]]'s {{p|Charmeleon}} and won. In the episode itself, Pyroar, under Lysandre's supervision, interrupted a battle with [[Alain's Charizard]] and [[Steven's Metagross]] with {{m|Flamethrower}}. Pyroar is always [[Walking Pokémon|out of his Poké Ball]]. In ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]'', he was seen with Lysandre while the latter instructed [[Alain]] and {{Steven}}. In another flashback in ''[[XYS04|Mega Evolution Special IV]]'' Pyroar is there when Lysandre gives Alain a [[Mega Ring]] and a [[Charizardite X]]. ====={{aniseries|XY}}===== Pyroar first appeared in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]''. In ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]'', Lysandre used him alongside his {{Shiny}} {{me|Gyarados}} to battle {{Ash}} and Alain, but he was defeated in a joint effort from Ash's Pokémon and Alain's Mega Charizard X. His whereabouts following [[XY136|the disappearance of his Trainer]] are unknown. ====Personality and characteristics==== [[File:Lysandre Pyroar 2.png|thumb|250px|Pyroar comfortably sleeping at Lysandre's abode]] Pyroar, as seen in ''[[XYS02|Mega Evolution Special II]]'', is very loyal to Lysandre, always following and helping him in any way he can. He is also a serious and a very tight challenger. In addition, Pyroar has a seemingly high temperament against others, except for his owner. When Pyroar distracted [[Alain]]'s Mega {{TP|Alain|Charizard}} X and {{Steven}}'s Mega {{TP|Steven|Metagross}} from their battle, and the two Pokémon reacted to him, Pyroar snarled furiously at them, owing to his fiery nature. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|fire|normal|Lysandre Pyroar {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Incinerate|2=Hyper Beam|3=Fire Fang}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Incinerate|2=Hyper Beam|3=Fire Fang}}}} {{anmov|Fire|Flamethrower|XYS02|Mega Evolution Special II}} {{anmov|Fire|Incinerate|XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!}} {{anmov|Normal|Hyper Beam|XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!}} {{anmov|Fire|Fire Fang|XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===Pokémon Generations=== [[File:Lysandre Pyroar PG.png|thumb|250px|Lysandre's Pyroar in [[Pokémon Generations]]]] Lysandre's Pyroar first appeared in ''[[PG16|The Beauty Eternal]]''. Before Lysandre appeared on stage, Pyroar fired a {{m|Flamethrower}} and then Lysandre appeared. Pyroar fired another Flamethrower as Lysandre suddenly teleported away. Lysandre then walked onstage, revealing that his first appearance was a hologram. He was always seen out of his Poké Ball. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|fire|normal|Lysandre Pyroar Flamethrower PG.png|Using Flamethrower}} {{anmov|Fire|Flamethrower|PG16|The Beauty Eternal}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ==In the games== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |gen=6 |caption='''{{g|X and Y}}

[[Pokémon Store#Amu Plaza Oita|Pokémon Store Amu Plaza Ōita]], {{wp|Ōita, Ōita|Ōita}}, Japan|November 5 to 11, 2016}} {{G6event/footer}} ==In the manga== [[File:Lysandre Pyroar Adventures.png|thumb|180px|Pyroar in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Pyroar first appeared in ''[[PS559|Chespin Sows the Seeds of Change]]''. He was first seen with Lysandre in Lysandre Café, where he was used to scare {{adv|Trevor}} into giving up a picture that was taken in [[Vaniville Town]]. Pyroar was stopped by [[Diantha]], who had her {{TP|Diantha|Gardevoir}} Mega Evolve to make him back off. In ''[[PS579|Pyroar Breathes]]'', when {{adv|X}} infiltrated the Team Flare Secret HQ to stop Team Flare's plan, Lysandre used Pyroar and the rest of his team to attack the intruder. It initially battled X's [[Salamè]] before it was recalled. Afterward, Pyroar battled X's [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga]]. With the heat of its flames, Pyroar forced Li'l Kanga into hiding back inside its mother's pouch to avoid being burned. When Kanga attempted to retaliate, Pyroar easily overpowered it and slammed it onto the ground. In ''[[PS590|Yveltal Steals]]'', Pyroar was used alongside Lysandre's other Pokémon to battle {{adv|Mewtwo}} at the [[Pokémon Village]] in order to capture it. When Lysandre's plan to trick Mewtwo into battling X and {{adv|Blue}} and weaken it enough for capture failed, Pyroar and the rest of Lysandre's team battled against Mewtwo again after it Mega Evolved into Mega Mewtwo Y. When Lysandre summoned [[Emma|Essentia]] and had her use {{p|Zygarde}}'s {{m|Land's Wrath}}, the attack's area of effect hit Pyroar and {{p|Mienfoo}} as well, knocking them both out. When {{adv|Y}} had her {{p|Absol|Solsol}} attack Lysandre in order to take the [[Key Stone|Mega Ring]] off of his hand, Lysandre had Pyroar attack to get Solsol off. Though it managed to throw Solsol off, Lysandre's Mega Ring was taken, causing him to lose the ability to use Mega Evolution. Afterward, Pyroar and Gyarados were used to battle X's Mega-Evolved team. Due to X using multiple Mega Evolutions at once, he was unable to focus on anything other than Zygarde, leaving him wide open to be attacked by Pyroar and Gyarados. Before their attacks could reach, {{adv|Blaine}} and Blue arrived and defeated Pyroar and Gyarados with Mewtwo and {{TP|Blue|Charizard}}, respectively. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|fire|normal|Lysandre Pyroar {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Hyper Voice|1=Noble Roar}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Hyper Voice|1=Noble Roar}}}} {{anmov|Normal|Hyper Voice|PS579|Pyroar Breathes}} {{anmov|Normal|Noble Roar|PS590|Yveltal Steals}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ==In the TCG== This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Lysandre's Pyroar in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Lysandre's Pyroar|Fire|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Forbidden Light|Pyroar|19}}|type=Fire|enset=Forbidden Light|enrarity=Rare Holo|ennum=19/131|jpset=Forbidden Light|jprarity=R|jpnum=016/094}} {{cardlist/footer|Fire}} ===Merchandise=== ====Secret Teams Sleeves==== January 20, 2018 saw the start of the Team Rainbow Rocket's Ambition campaign in Japan, which among its {{DL|List of local event Pokémon distributions in Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon#Team Rainbow Rocket's Ambition Pokémon|special distributions}}, also included a plethora of [[villainous team]]-related merchandise. Associated TCG products included seven {{DL|Pikachu (TCG)|Pretend Boss Pikachu}} {{TCG|SM-P Promotional cards}} and seven sets of card sleeves, each focusing on the primary antagonists from [[core series]] titles. All sleeves come in packs of 64 and were exclusive to Pokémon Centers.
